newsitem.title: USA: CoreStates Financial Corp Q3 oper net up.
newsitem.headline: CoreStates Financial Corp Q3 oper net up.

text.p: (All Data Above 000s Except Per Share Numbers)
NOTE: Q3 and nine months 1996 oper net excludes $8.9 million SAIF assessment.
Oper net excludes net investment gains of $18.6 million vs $52,000 in Q3 and $28.1 million vs $7.7 million for nine months.
Q3 oper net excludes restructuring/merger-related charge of $7.7 million vs gain of $1.5 million.
Nine month oper net exlcudes restructuring/merger-related charges of $144.8 million vs $87.3 million.
Nine months 1995 net exlcudes $11.8 million gain on exchange of equity securities.
Revs is net interest income plus non-interest income.
Nine months 1995 loan loss prov includes $70 million that was part of merger-related charges.
Total assets at current peior end were $45.2 bln.
